<italic>to bend</italic>,] 
<italic>to yoke, put to work</italic>. Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> (בריחיים) כּוֹדְנוֹ לריחיים he puts his father to treading the mill (Bab. ib. 31
<sup>a</sup> bot. מטחינו, v. טָחַן). Y. Pes. IV, 31

<notes>—Part. pass. מְכוּדָּן. Lam. R. to I, 14 (ref. to נפש חיה, Gen. II, 7, as if meaning

<italic>Pl. fem</italic>. מְכוּדָּנוֹת. Lev. R. s. 16 (play on יְשִׂפַּח, Is. III, 17) עשאן שְׁפָחוֹת מכ' the enemies made them handmaids, forced to hard labor; ib. מהו מ' אמהן משעבדן; Lam. R. to IV, 15 מכודניות (corr. acc.).—V. כּוּדְנָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00151">
<head-word>כֵּהֶה, </head-word>
<head-word>כֵּו'</head-word>
<head-word>כֵּהָה, </head-word>
<head-word>כֵּי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (of light) 
<italic>dim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 31 בשעה שהיא כ' when it (the jewel) shone faintly.—
<plural-form>Pl. כֵּהִים, כֵּהוֹת, כֵּי'</plural-form>. Ib.; Y. Pes. I, beg. 27
<sup>a</sup> בשעה שהיו כ' וכ' when the lights burned dimly, we knew it was day-time. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> top בשעה שהיו כיהות when the jewels were dim.—Pesik. Kumi, p. 145
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to כ̇ה̇חלנות Ez. XL, 25) חלונות כ' היו the windows were dim (stained glass). Ḥag. 16
<sup>a</sup> עיניו כ' his eyes will grow dim; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of leprosy) 
<italic>faint, dull</italic>, opp. עזה.</definition>
<notes> Neg, II, 1, v. בַּהֶרֶת. Ib. 2 לפי שהכ'נראית עזה because (in the early morning &c.) the faint spot appears bright; Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. II, ch. II.—Y. Shebu. I, 32
<sup>d</sup> הִכְהָה טמא הִכְ' מן הַכֵּ' טהור if it grows one shade fainter, it is unclean, but when it grows fainter than the next fainter shade, it is clean; Sifra l. c. ed. Ven.; Yalk. Lev. 551 כִּיהָה מן הכֵּ'; Y. l. c.; a. fr.—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*3)</number>
<definition> (trnsf.) 
<italic>doubtful</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 19
<sup>a</sup>; Naz. 65
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 87
<sup>b</sup>; Keth. 75
<sup>b</sup> ר' י' אומר כ' R. Josh. says, It is doubtful; (Neg. IV, 11 ר' י' קֵיהָה or כִּיהָה, v. כהי, קהי).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00152">
<head-word>כְּהוּנָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">כְּהֻנָּה; v. כֹּהֵן)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>priesthood, priestly privileges; priestly community.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 13. Sot. 11
<sup>b</sup> בתי כ' priestly families. Midd. I, 8, a. fr. פרחי כ' young priests (novices). Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>a</sup> top אין כ' היום there is no priesthood to-day (the laws for priests are suspended on the day of Rabbi’s funeral). Tosef. Ḥall. II, 7, a. fr. כ"ד מתנות כ' twenty-four gifts of priesthood (priestly prerogatives). Keth. 14
<sup>a</sup> כשרה לכ' fit to marry into the priesthood; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00153">
<head-word>כְּהוּנְּתָא, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּהוּנְתָּא</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Targ. Ex. XXIX, 9. Targ. Num. XVI, 10 כ' רבתא high-priesthood; a. fr.—Targ. O. Ex. XL, 15 כְּהוּנַת ed. Berl. (ed. כַּהֲנוּת).—Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>c</sup> סליקא לכ' she rose to priesthood (as a priest’s wife); נחיתא מן כ' went down from priesthood (ceased to enjoy priestly privileges as a priest’s wife).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00155">

<entry id="K00156">
<head-word>כהי, </head-word>
<head-word>כָּהָה</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. כָּוָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be dim</italic> (of sight, 
<pgbrk id="pg615" />light).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 65 כָּהוּ עיניו his eyes grew dim. Ib. שיִכְהוּ עיניו that his eye-sight shall fail. Kidd. 24
<sup>b </sup>
<sub>…</sub> הכהו וכָהֲתָה if the master struck him on his eye, and it grew dim; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּהוּי, f. כָּהוּיָה. Ib. הרי שהיתה עינו כ' וכ' if his eye-sight was dim, and he (the master) made him perfectly blind.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of color) 
<italic>to be dull</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="K00150">כֵּהֶה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> [Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 8; Tanḥ. Noah 9, v. כָּחַח.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כִּיהָה, כִּהָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to grow duller, to be shaded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II אם העז וכ' if the spot grew brighter and grew duller again; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>to declare doubtful.</italic> Neg. IV, 11 ר' י' כ', v. כֵּהֶה.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְהָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Y. Shebu. I, 32 same.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebu. I, 32
<sup>d</sup>, v. כֵּהֶה. Neg. XI, 5 ה' בתחלה if the suspicious spot grew fainter at once (before the ordered isolation was begun); ה' בראשון if it grew faint in the first week; Tosef. ib. V, 6 quot. in R. S. to Neg. l. c. (ed. Zuck. כהה כתחלה, oth. ed. only כתחלה, corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make dim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. l. c. הריני מַכְהֶה וכ' I will make his eye-sight dim. Yalk. Ruth 601 ייסורין מַכְהִין וכ' … sufferings of poverty dim men’s eyes. Pesik. R. s. 14 מכהה גלגל חמה dimmed (outshone) the sun in brightness; Pesik. Parah, p. 37
<sup>a</sup> שיַכְהֶה; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00157">
<head-word>כְּהִי, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּהָא</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Targ. Gen. XXVII, 1. Targ. I Kings XIV, 4; a. e.—Y. Ned. IX, 41
<sup>b</sup> bot. עיני כַּהֲיָיא my eye-sight is failing.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כַּהֵי, כַּהֵה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dim, make blind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 69
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 64
<sup>a</sup> כַּהֲיִינְהוּ לעיניה Ar. (ed. כחלינהו, cmp. כְּבִי) they made his eye-sight dim. Ib. 27
<sup>a</sup> ליכַהֲיוּהוּ לעיניה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) he shall be blinded.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (sub. לִבֵּיה) 
<italic>to be angry;</italic> (with ב־ of person) 
<italic>to rebuke</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Sam. III, 13.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַכְהֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ez. XXXII, 7 באַכְהָיוּתִי when I make dim (h. text בכבותך).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make the heart faint, to annoy, reproach</italic> (
<italic>falsely</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Ib. XIII, 22 אַכְהֵיתִין לב וכ' ye denounced the heart of the righteous to be false (h. text הכאות).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְכְּהִי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be reproached</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. (h. text הכאבתיו).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00163">
<head-word>כֹּהֵן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="K00163"> כהן</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , v. 
<xref rid="K00296">כּוּן</xref>; cmp. b. h. כַּן) [
<italic>standing, stationed</italic>,] 
<italic>officer</italic>, esp. 
<italic>priest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 6
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כ' גדול (abbr. כ"ג) high priest, כ' הדיוט ordinary priest. Meg. I, 9 כ' משוח an anointed high priest, contrad. to מרובה בגדים a high priest distinguished only by his robes (but not anointed, as in the days of the Second Temple). Ib. כ' משמש officiating highpriest, כ' שעבר a substitute of the high priest no longer required, ex-substitute. Hor. III, 8 ממזר … קודם לכ"ג ע"ה a bastard who is a scholar has the precedence of an ignorant high priest; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כֹּהֲנִים</plural-form>. Yeb. 86
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. בכ"ד מקומות נקראו הכ' וכ in twenty four Biblical passages the priests are designated as Levites; a. v. fr.—תּוֹרַת כֹּהֲנִים (abbr. ת"כ) 
<italic>Torath Kohănim</italic>, a) name of 
<italic>the third book of Moses, Leviticus</italic>. Kidd. 33
<sup>a</sup>. Lev. R. s. 7 מפני מה … בת"כ why do we, in teaching children, commence with Leviticus? a. e.—b) name of 
<italic>an halachic commentary to Leviticus</italic>, also named 
<italic>Sifra</italic>. Yeb. 72
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Fem. כֹּהֶנֶת, כּוֹהֶ' 
<italic>a priest’s daughter</italic> or 
<italic>wife</italic>. Ḥull. 131
<sup>b</sup>, sq.—Keth. IV, 8 ובכ' and in the case of a priest’s wife. Ib. VII, 1, sq. (70
<sup>a</sup>) ובכ' Mish. a. Y. ed. (Bab. ed. ובכהן). Ib. 71
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כֹּהֲנוֹת, כּוֹהֲ'</plural-form>. Ber. 44
<sup>a</sup>. Yeb. III, 10 אם היו כ' (Y. ed. כוה') if they are daughters of priests; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00165">
<head-word>כָּהֵן, </head-word>
<head-word>כָּהֵין, </head-word>
<head-word>כַּהֲנָא, </head-word>

<xref rid="K00163">כֹּהֵן.</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>all, every one; any</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Constr. כָּל (frequ. used absolutely). Targ. O. Gen. XVI, 12, sq. Targ. Ex. XX, 9. Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 49 לא כל היאך not at all as (thou sayest); a. fr.—Y. Yoma VIII, 45
<sup>b</sup> bot. לא כולא מן הדין וכ' all does not depend upon this man (it is not at all within his power) to say to the king, Thou art no king, i.e. his saying that the Day of Atonement has no atoning power, cannot affect its power; Y. Shebu. II, 33
<sup>b</sup> bot.—Snh. 46
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. (לאו) לא כל כמיניה all is not as if dependent on him, i.e. he has no power to &c. Gen. R. s. 79, beg. (expl. בכלח, Job V, 26) תבא בכולא אלי וכ' (some ed. בכוֹלָּה) thou shalt enter the grave in fulness, full, wanting nothing.—כָּל דְּכֵן = h. כָּל שֶׁכֵּן, v. כֹּל. Targ. Job IV, 19; a. fr.—Nidd. 51
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—כָּל עלמא, v. infra.—With suffix כּוּלָךְ, כּוּלֵיה &c. (Buxt. כֻּלָּךְ &c.) 
<italic>all of thee, of him</italic> &c., 
<italic>entire</italic>. Targ. Gen. XXV, 25; a. fr.—Yoma 14
<sup>b</sup> כוליה יומא the entire day; ib. 19
<sup>a</sup> (not כולי). Ib. 26
<sup>a</sup> כּוּלְהוּ מצפרא אתו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) all of them come in (for their share) by the lots cast in the morning; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. constr. כּוּלֵי</plural-form>
<italic>all of</italic>. Targ. Esth. VI, 1 כ' ליליא (ed. Lag. כוליה). Targ. Koh. X, 12 כ' עלמא (ed. Lag. כוליה).—Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>b</sup> כ' עלמא ידעין ed. Lehm. (ed. כל) all the world, 
<italic>all people</italic> know (abbr. כ"ע); Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> bot. כל עמא; v. עָלְמָא. Kidd. 79
<sup>b</sup>, v. כּוּל ch.—כ' האי all of that, 
<italic>to that extent</italic>. Erub. 61
<sup>a</sup>. B. Mets. 84
<sup>b</sup> כ' ה' ודאי וכ' after it has come to all this (it being so well known), it is surely not proper. Ab. Zar. 24
<sup>a</sup>; a. v. fr.—Ḥag. 4
<sup>b</sup> כ' ה' ואולי all this (is required of us) and yet only ‘perhaps’ (Zeph. II, 3)! Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup> כ' ה' ואפשר all this (trouble) and ‘only perhaps’!—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>capacity, power</italic> (cmp. יכל).</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah VIII, 20
<sup>d</sup> bot. לא כָּלָּן מסתור וכ' our (my) strength consists not in tearing down but &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00296">
<head-word>כּוּן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to stand, exist, be firm</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כִּיוֵּון</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to straighten</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 308 מְכַוְּונוֹ במעגילה he tries to straighten the wood in a press; Yalk. Deut. 942 (not מכינן); Pesik. Zutr. Haăz. (ed. Bub. V, p. 111) נתנו לאומן שיְכַוְּונוֹ he gave it to a mechanic to straighten it.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place in a line, direct</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Macc. II, 5 (9
<sup>b</sup>) מְכַוְּונִין להן דרך וכ' Ms. M. (ed. ומְכוּוָּנוֹת להן דרכים, v. infra) we make for them direct roads from one place of refuge to the other.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to determine exactly</italic> (place, time &c.).</definition>
<notes> Y. Erub. V, 22
<sup>c</sup> לְכַוֵּין את הרוחות how to determine exactly the four cardinal points (v. רָבַע). Ib. bot. הארון היה מְכַוֵּין וכ' the Ark indicated for them the points of the compass. Gen. R. s. 15, beg., v. כִּוּוּן. M. Kat. 10
<sup>a</sup> אין יכול לכַוֵּין אימרא וכ' is unable to sew the fringe accurately on the bosom of the shirt. Ber. 7
<sup>a</sup> לכַוֵּין אותה שעה to seize the opportunity of just that moment; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (with לב or sub. לב) 
<italic>to direct</italic> or 
<italic>prepare one’s mind, to pay attention, to do a thing with an intention</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. II, 1 אם כ' לבו if he (while reading in the Law) had his mind directed (to the Sh’ma); ib. 13
<sup>a</sup> אם כ' לבו לקרות it means, he read with attention (to the sense, not merely like one going over the text for correction). R. Hash. 28
<sup>b</sup> כ' לבו לצאת he had the intention of complying with the law (v. יָצָא); opp. (כ') לשמוע he directed his attention to listening, i.e. heard the sound with consciousness (but without devotion); v. כַּוָּונָה. Ber. V, 1 היו שוהין … כדי שיְכַוְּונוּ לבם וכ' tarried a while before prayer, in order to direct their hearts to their Father in heaven. Y. ib. II, 5
<sup>a</sup> חזקה כִּוֵּין the presumption is that he read with attention; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְכוּוָּן, f. מְכוּוָּנָה, מְכוּוֶּנֶת; pl. מְכוּוָּנִים, … נִין; מְכוּוָּנוֹת a) 
<italic>in a line, corresponding</italic>. Y. Kil. V, beg. 30
<sup>b</sup> עריס המכ' a straight bed of vines, opp. מעוקם. Ib. מכ' הן they (the vines) are in a straight line. Y. Ber. IV, 8
<sup>c</sup> top בית … מ' כנגד … של מעלן the situation of the earthly Holy of Holies corresponds with that of the heavenly &c. Macc. II, 5 ומכוונות להן דרכים (not … נת), v. supra. Ib. 9
<sup>b</sup> ומכוונות היו כמין וכ' (Ms. M. ומכוונין הן) and they (the three towns on this side and those on the other side of the Jordan respectively) were in straight parallel lines like two rows in a vineyard; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>exact, precise.</italic> Toh. III, 1 sq. כביצה מ' exactly the quantity of an egg. Mikv. VII, 6; Ḥag. 19
<sup>a</sup>; Gitt. 16
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵכִין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to put in proper position, to prepare; to hold ready, to designate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. XVI, 5) חול מֵכִין לשבתוכ' a week day prepares for the Sabbath (that which has become ready for use on a week day may be used on the Sabbath), but a Holy Day does not prepare for the succeeding Sabbath, ואין שבת מֵכִינָה ליו"ט nor can the Sabbath prepare for a succeeding Holy Day, v. הֲכָנָה.—Meg. 12
<sup>b</sup> (play on ממוכן, Esth. I, 14) כלום הֵכִינוּ וכ' have they (the Persians) arranged a table before thee?; Esth. R. to l. c. מי מֵכִין וכ' who arranges an altar &c.?; a. fr.—[Tosef. Maasr. I, 4 משיכינו ed. Zuck., Var. משייבינו, read: משיניצו.]—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מוּכָן 
<italic>prepared, designated, ready</italic>. Bets. I, 2 עפר מ' מבעוד יום dust (for covering the blood) made ready a day before. Ib. אפר כירה מ' הוא ashes of the stove are considered ready (destined to be used for the purpose). Ib. III, 4 אין זה מן המ' this is not among the things designated for use on the Holy Day. Ib. IV, 6.—Meg. l. c. (play on ממוכן, v. supra) שמ' לפורענות he was ready for evil; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְכַּיֵּון, הִתְכַּוֵּון, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְכַּוֵּין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be made straight, to be remedied</italic> (cmp. תכן).</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Zutr. l. c. אין אתם מִתְכַּוְּונִים אלא באור you (your crookedness) can be remedied only through fire; Sifré Deut. l. c. אין אתם הולכים אלא לאור; Yalk. Deut l. c. הולכין אלא לאחור (corr. acc.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prepare one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> (ref. to הִכּוֹן, Am. IV, 12) הִתְכַּוֵּון לקראת וכ' put thyself in proper condition to meet thy God.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to intend, propose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. VIII. 1 עד שיהא מִתְכַּ יֵן unless he did it with malicious intent. Tosef. Naz. III, 10 לא נִתְכַּוַּונְתִּי אלא כמותה my intention 
<pgbrk id="pg622" />was to be exactly like her (as to her vow). Ib. 14 מי שנ' לעלות וכ' if he who had the intention to eat the flesh of swine &c.; v. עָלָה. Sabb. 22
<sup>a</sup> ובלבד שלא יִתְכַּוֵּין וכ' provided he has not the intention of making a groove.—Bets. 23
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. דבר שאינו מִתְכַּ' a forbidden act which was produced without intent, i.e. an unintended but unavoidable effect of a permitted act. R. Hash. 28
<sup>b</sup>. Pes. 53
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. שניהם … נִתְכַּוְּונוּ both meant the same thing; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Polel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כּוֹנֵן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to establish, base firmly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 15 מבקש לְכוֹנֵן עולמים wanted to establish worlds. Ib. על אלו אני מְכוֹנֵן וכ' upon those (the patriarchs) I will establish the world.—Part. pass. מְכוֹנָן, f. מְבוֹנֶנֶת. Midr. Sam. ch. XVI (ref. to הכינני, I Kings II, 24) בזכות התורה המ' בארון (the world exists) for the sake of the Law that is put up straight in the holy Ark.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00297">
<head-word>כּוּן</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> כַּוֵּון </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to direct, aim, draw a direct line</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 23. Targ. Num. XXXIV, 7, sq. (h. text תאה). Targ. Y. Deut. X, 5 וכוונית (h. text פנה). Ib. XIX, 3 (h. text תכין, v. preced.); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to draw a parallel, compare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XLVI, 5 (h. text תמשילני).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with דעתא, or sub. דעתא) 
<italic>to direct the mind, to pay attention; to do a thing intentionally</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XI, 1 מכ' והגיאן ביש intentionally speaking evil.—Ber. 17
<sup>b</sup> לא מצי לְכַוּוּנֵי דעתיה he cannot collect his mind (for prayer). Ib. 30
<sup>b</sup> מעיקרא לא כ' וכ' the first time he read without attention. Ḥull. 31
<sup>a</sup> דלא קָמְכַוֵּין (or קָמִכַּוֵּין 
<italic>Ithpa.</italic>) when he had no intention whatever (to cut); a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְכַוַּון a) 
<italic>directed towards, corresponding</italic>. Targ. Ez. I, 9. Targ. Ex. XXVI, 5; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>straight, firm, upright</italic>. Targ. Job XXI, 8 מְכַוְּונִין Bxt. (Ms. מְכַוְּונַן; ed. מכוין, מְכַוַּון, corr. acc.; h. text נכון). Targ. Ps. LI, 12. Ib. LVII, 8 (ed. Wil. מכוֵן, corr. acc.); a. fr.—Yoma 28
<sup>b</sup> לא מְכַוְּונֵי Ms. M. (ed. לא מ' טובא) the Temple walls were not exactly straight (the lower portions being thicker than the upper); [Ms. M. 2 משום דמכווני because the walls were exactly built in correspondence with the points of the compass]. Y. Snh. IV, beg. 22
<sup>a</sup>; III, 21
<sup>c</sup> top [read:] כד הוא חמי סהדו מכַוְּונָא … הכן והכן מְכַוֵּון when he found evidences (of two) exactly corresponding, he cross-examined; but when he found them turning hither and thither (differing in details), he tried to harmonize (allowing for errors in time &c., v. חֲקִירָה).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְכַּוֵּון, אִיכַּ', </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, כַּוֵּין … </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place one’s self, to stand</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Ps. CI, 7.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be precise in doing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. XC, 12 מן יִתְכַּ' להודע ed. Lag. (oth. ed. כן, corr. acc.) who can exactly make known? (h. text כן הודע). Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 12.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be trained, to be in the habit of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 30 (h. text הסכן).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to intend, mean</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. XXX, 5 ויתכ' וישתוק and keeps silence intentionally. Targ. Y. Deut. XIX, 4; a. e.—Ḥull. 95
<sup>a</sup> דאיכ' לצעורי' וכ' who meant to vex his neighbor. Ib. 31
<sup>a</sup> מִיכַּוֵּין לשום חתיכה had the intention merely to cut (not to slaughter according to the ritual, v. זְבִיחָה). Ib. מה כלים דלא מִיכַּוְּונֵי וכ' as vessels (lifeless things) which have no thought &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְכָּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be prepared, ready</italic> (מוּכָן, v. 
<xref rid="K00296">preced.</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> כיון דלא א' וכ' because it was not prepared (designated for use) yesterday.—V. תכן.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>sh’ma</italic> to 
<italic>e</italic>
